The '''Febrini system''' was located in the [[Gateworlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rynmar Trail]] to the [[Sargon system/Legends|Sargon system]] of the Gateworlds and to the [[Rynmar system/Legends|Rynmar system]] in the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]], and another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the Gateworlds' [[Zadaria system/Legends|Zadaria system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Febrini [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Febrini sand-prestor]]s.<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Febrini system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
